title: HTTP route owns database internals
diff:
diff --git a/api/routes.py b/api/routes.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/api/routes.py
+++ b/api/routes.py
@@ -1,2 +1,8 @@
+from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text
+from fastapi import APIRouter
+router = APIRouter()
+engine = create_engine('postgresql://app:password@db/app')
+@router.get('/users')
+def get_users():
+    with engine.connect() as connection:
+        return connection.execute(text('select * from users')).all()
